name: media.concat
title: Media concat
summary: Join two or more clips: stream copy for sections rendered with identical settings, or the concat filter to re-encode across differing sources.
description: Concatenates video files in order. copy uses the concat demuxer with -c copy (fast, requires identical codecs, resolution and frame rate); reencode uses the concat filter and re-encodes video (and audio when every input has it).

items.description: A clip: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>.

inputs.description: Clips to join, in playback order (2 to 200).

mode.description: copy = concat demuxer with stream copy (identical settings); reencode = concat filter that re-encodes.

video.description: Video encoder settings used by reencode; omit (or leave fields out) to accept ffmpeg defaults. Ignored by copy.

codec.description: Video codec for reencode, e.g. libx264 (the default) or libx265.

preset.description: Encoder preset for reencode, e.g. veryfast or slow.

crf.description: Constant rate factor for reencode (lower is better quality).

pix_fmt.description: Pixel format for reencode, e.g. yuv420p (the default).

audio.description: Audio encoder settings used by reencode when every input has audio. Ignored by copy.

bitrate_k.description: Audio bit rate in kbit/s for reencode (default 192).

name.description: Output file name inside the job's out folder, e.g. concat.mp4.

examples.title: Re-encode concat with a scale-friendly preset
